{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 with NaN to mark as missing
sales_df['customer_age'] = sales_df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Recalculate the mean age, excluding missing values
mean_age_cleaned = sales_df['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_cleaned"}
